Common questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Can a surveillance system be viewed remotely?

Remote viewing is available with many camera systems when configured with a suitable network and access controls.

Can solutions scale for larger sites?

Yes. The system design can be planned around multiple areas, buildings, and users.

Can new cameras work with existing systems?

Compatibility depends on the existing hardware and software. We can review this during planning.
